scope: one independent run; fixed protocol/data fingerprint; validation-only evidence

layers.immutable_observations: every completed candidate, no 50-record truncation in archive; versioned/checksummed atomic JSON; conflicting rewrites rejected
layers.program_archive: exact before/after source files addressed by SHA256; AST hashes support source-duplicate checks
layers.hot_state: last 50 observations plus last 8 textual lessons; full archive remains retrievable
layers.lifecycle_events: append separate idempotent jump acceptance/rejection/incomplete-window events; interpret historical observations without overwriting them
layers.request_context: balanced retrieval by source, arm, basin, best validation, negative evidence and recency; at most 12 records and 18000 Unicode characters; each request context saved for review

record_fields: original hypothesis and original/repair proposal history
actual parameter source-expression changes and changed method names
before/after raw and AST-normalized hashes; patch hash and excerpt
group-best vs promoted vs provisional status
input validation score, local delta and global delta
all worker attempts, total GPU cost, errors, cap and repair history
same-program prior evidence and identical-checkpoint-set reference
jump window ID and reconciled final outcome
duplicate_policy: reject previously successful AST-identical programs within this run before GPU dispatch; existing three implementation attempts request a different edit; failed/time-limited configurations remain repairable; no cross-run response/checkpoint reuse
retrieval_policy: coverage first, verbose excerpts second; irrelevant provisional source snapshots and inherited generic memory payloads excluded; old high-quality or negative observations remain accessible beyond the hot window
training_facts: only supplied train files: user/item history counts, repeat counts, median/p95 length, number of histories above 128; supplied to hypothesis and implementation stages
interpretation_rules: one validation result is a configuration-specific observation, not a general causal claim
timeout at a recorded cap is censored performance evidence, not proof of poor model quality
accepted jump includes retune effects, with no isolated component attribution
rolled-back basin observations remain historical and are not the active incumbent
source expressions are not claimed to be resolved runtime parameter values
AST identity is not general functional equivalence; identical checkpoints do not prove identical predictions
limits: no held-out-test feedback or cross-run historical import
archive restoration supports evidence retrieval; it does not authorize automatic experiment resume
data-dependent no-ops beyond exact source/weight identity still require independent validation
